summary: Iteration 5 verification of the production socket.io path fix + baseline regression checks. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests pass (engine.io handshake on /api/socket.io returns 200 with '0{...sid...}', root /socket.io correctly 404s, full polling session handshake->40 namespace connect ack works through the preview ingress, health OK, closed-trades baseline intact at total=191/winRate=49.2/totalProfitUSD=-1117.30, dual-env live+demo both AUTHENTICATED, /api/feed returns posts). Frontend: with a session present the app opens a socket.io connection using ONLY polling on /api/socket.io (5 requests captured: 1 handshake GET + 4 sid-bound GET/POST), console logs '[SocketClient] Connected ... 25ab9Wa6WHV8B8mdAAAH', and NO socket.io WebSocket upgrade is attempted (only the Vite HMR wss:// dev socket appears). Feed renders 8 position-progress-bar elements; XAUUSD closed card shows -$7.80 and -0.19% badge as baseline. No blocking issues found.

minor.issue: Server handshake still advertises upgrades:["websocket"] (AsyncServer allow_upgrades=True). Harmless for this app's client (upgrade:false), but any third-party/reconnecting client would try a WS upgrade that prod ingress cannot proxy. Consider allow_upgrades=False for consistency.

integration_issues.issue: Backend now emits `market:tick` on every spot event, but there is NO listener anywhere in /app/frontend/src (grep for 'market:tick' returns nothing) and socketClient exposes no onMarketTick subscription. The new broadcast is currently a dead payload on the client side.

socketClient.connect() is only invoked in App.tsx L436 when currentUser?.id exists. Unauthenticated (public preview) visitors never open a socket, so market:tick / live price movement can never reach guest sessions even after a broker connects.

sio.emit('market:tick', ...) in ticker.py has no room/namespace scoping, so every tick is broadcast to every connected client over polling. With polling-only transport this multiplies long-poll traffic; consider a symbol room or client-side subscribe.

action_items: Optional: add a `market:tick` listener/subscription (onMarketTick) in socketClient.ts and wire it to price widgets, otherwise the new backend emit is unused.
Optional: connect socket.io for guest sessions (or document that realtime is authenticated-only).
Optional: set allow_upgrades=False on socketio.AsyncServer so the handshake does not advertise a websocket upgrade prod ingress cannot serve.

Note: uvicorn --reload watches /app/backend including tests/, so writing a test file restarts the backend and briefly drops cTrader auth (states go CONNECTING and API calls fail for ~30s). Consider a reload-exclude for tests/ to avoid false failures.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L4177 socketio_path='/api/socket.io' + socketClient.ts path '/api/socket.io' are consistent and verified end-to-end through the preview ingress.

socketClient.ts uses io() with no explicit URL (same-origin). This works in preview/prod where frontend and backend share the origin, but it ignores REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — it will break if the two are ever split across origins.
ticker.py market:tick emit is inside handle_spot_event with no throttle; at high spot rates this can flood the socket.io broadcast queue.

Log check: '[cTrader.Client] Dual-env clients ready: main=live, alt=demo' appears ONCE per boot (not twice as the request expected) — informational only, dual-env is healthy per /api/ctrader/connection/status.
seed_data_creation: None. Frontend session simulated by setting localStorage scrolic_user_id='ptsmiea' (no data written).
test_credentials: None required; /app/memory/test_credentials.md documents that all users currently have ctrader_connected=false, so no live spot events fire.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_socketio_prod_path.py` for the socket.io + baseline regression suite. IMPORTANT: creating/editing any file under /app/backend triggers uvicorn --reload; wait ~40s before asserting cTrader AUTHENTICATED state. To exercise the browser socket path without Google OAuth, set localStorage 'scrolic_user_id' to 'ptsmiea' then reload — App.tsx will resolve currentUser and call socketClient.connect(). market:tick cannot be observed end-to-end until a cTrader OAuth session exists AND a frontend listener is added.
